colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Primary text, hairline borders, structural lines - the dominant neutral carrying all interface weight

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: Strongest text and most emphatic borders, logo dots, footer marks

colors.name: Paper
colors.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, nav backgrounds - the unbroken white field everything floats on

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: Muted helper text, secondary borders, dimmed metadata

colors.name: Periwinkle
colors.role: Sole chromatic accent - selected nav state, badge fills, a rare pressure point in an otherwise colorless system

fonts.name: GillSansNova-Book
fonts.role: Primary typeface for body, headings, nav, links, and icon-adjacent text - carries the entire English typographic system at a medium weight with wide tracking

fonts.name: GillSansNova-SemiBold
fonts.role: Emphasis and key headings - the bolder weight creates hierarchy without size inflation; the 8px variant carries micro-labels and badge text

fonts.name: (Yu Gothic)
fonts.role: Japanese text rendering - sits at the same metric scale as the English system, ensuring bilingual visual parity

fonts.name: CezannePro-DB
fonts.role: Micro-decorative and brand-specific marks - a secondary display face for labels that need a different visual texture from the main Gill system

fonts.name: GillSansNova-Medium
fonts.role: GillSansNova-Medium - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

do: Use uppercase with letter-spacing 0.07em for all interface text - this tracking is the typographic signature, not the weight or size
Separate content containers with 1px #2d2d2d or #000000 hairline borders, never with background fills or shadows
Keep the 3px border-radius for every rounded element - a sharper, more architectural system than the common 8-16px
Limit color to the neutrals plus periwinkle #738ae5; let the periwinkle appear on at most 1-2 elements per view as a quiet accent
Set body text at 16-18px with 1.22-1.33 line-height and 0.07-0.1em letter-spacing for an editorial gallery feel
Use GillSansNova-SemiBold (weight 800) at 8px with 0.119em tracking for all micro-labels, badges, and category stamps
Apply the "palt" font-feature setting globally - it optimizes proportional alternates and is non-negotiable for the brand's typographic identity
doNot: Do not introduce shadows, gradients, or any form of elevation - the design system is flat by philosophy
Do not add bright or saturated colors beyond #738ae5; even secondary accents should stay neutral
Do not use border-radius above 3px; avoid pill shapes and large rounded corners
Do not set type in mixed case or normal letter-spacing; everything reads as editorial display via tracking
Do not fill cards or sections with tinted backgrounds; rely on hairline borders to create structure on the white canvas
Do not use large display type below 28px or above 32px - the scale is deliberately compressed and quiet
Do not add icons with weight above 1px stroke; icons are absent or drawn as the thinnest possible lines
